title: Osun 2026 off-cycle governorship election — collected PVCs

records.breakdown: Certified polling-unit level breakdown is linked from the INEC PVC Statistics page.

methodology: Direct transcription of the latest Osun 2026 release displayed on INEC's PVC Statistics page.
limitations: The page identifies this as a certified polling-unit-level breakdown of 1,518,485 collected PVCs across 30 LGAs.
A specific publication date or PVC collection cutoff date was not displayed on the page reviewed; do not invent one.
This is an Osun election-specific collection count, not a national CVR total.
The page snippet does not provide the registered-voter denominator, so a collection rate cannot be calculated from this record alone.
